behaviour: Every job of the Lab check workflow installs each third party distribution that the modules its run lines start with python -m import at module level, followed through every local scripts, hooks and tests module those imports reach; imports inside function bodies and under TYPE_CHECKING are not required, while a branch under not TYPE_CHECKING is. A job whose install words miss one names the module and the local module importing it, a module no installed distribution provides is refused by name, and a workflow that runs no python -m entry is refused.
seam: tests.contracts.test_lab_check_installs.missing_installs over .github/workflows/lab-check.yml and the scripts.ci_lab.checks import closure
